messages:
mina: devsec-bot flagged a leaked partner secret in archived logs (partner-sync service). Pattern PARTNER_KEY_xxx found in archive/2024/10/12/partner-sync.log. High priority.

devsec-bot: (automated) leak=detected severity=high path=s3://archives/partner-sync/2024/10/12/partner-sync.log pattern=PARTNER_KEY_xxx

chris: I'll own rotation + containment. First step: ask partner to revoke existing key, then rotate in Vault and rewrap with KMS.

mina: Confirmed key present in old deploy tag v1.0.0 config and an older Vault entry at secret/data/integrations/partner-sync. No recent use in ingress logs (last seen 2024-11). Still treat as compromised.

chris: Commands I'm running now (redacted):
```bash
# write new key to Vault kv v2
vault kv put secret/integrations/partner-sync api_key=$NEWKEY owner=chris rotated_at=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
# encrypt with GCP KMS
echo -n "$NEWKEY" | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=redwood --key=partners --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | base64 > partner_sync.enc
```

ops: Before rotation completes, enable a short-lived RBAC lockdown on secret path to reduce blast radius. Suggest 2-hour window.

chris: Created temporary policy 'lock-partner-sync' and bound to svc-account only. Policy applied at 2026-03-21T18:12Z. Example policy snippet posted in ticket.

mina: We also need archive remediation: add a log-scrub stage to the archiver and schedule a rewrite job for 2024-2025 archives. OWNER: ops.

ops: Kicking off archive-rewrite job JOB-8721 scope=2024-2025. Also adding pre-upload validation to reject files containing token-like regex.

chris: Partner confirmed revocation ticket PART-2026-499 accepted. New key uploaded via their portal. Rotation complete at 2026-03-21T18:28:20Z. Vault request_id=r-9f4b. KMS key version=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/partners/cryptoKeyVersions/7

legal: Please include timeline, affected services list, and audit entries in the incident ticket for compliance.

mina: Will compile. Proposed follow-up: move partner integrations to ephemeral short-lived tokens (10m TTL) and require no long-lived tokens in archives. Scheduling 30-min postmortem tomorrow.

devsec-bot: post-rotation-scan results: initial_matches=1 post_rotation_matches=0 scanned_path=s3://archives/partner-sync/2024/

chris: Good. I'll draft an RFC for ephemeral partner tokens and include migration plan. Closing containment, keeping ticket open for archive rewrite and RBAC cleanup.

mina: Thanks all — marking INCIDENT-2026-03-21-PSYNC in containment.
